svg.text: EVERY FAILURE HAS A DEFINED DESTINATION · EVERY DESTINATION HAS A WAY BACK
REDUCED CAPABILITY — STILL USEFUL, STILL REPORTING
OPERATOR LOCKOUT — AVAILABLE FROM ANY STATE
POWER LOSS IS NOT A STATE
SPRING-RETURN VALVES CLOSE BY PHYSICS. SOFTWARE DOES NOT PARTICIPATE AND MUST NOT ASSUME IT CAN.
MOST NODES SPEND MOST OF THEIR LIVES WITH INTERMITTENT
CONTACT. A NODE THAT PANICS ALONE IS BROKEN.
A NODE WITH NO WATER STILL CARRIES ITS NEIGHBOURS'
TRAFFIC. IT IS WORTH LEAVING ON THE WALL.
EVERY DEGRADED STATE HAS A RETURN PATH.
DEGRADATION IS A ROUTE, NOT A TERMINUS.
